Coupled Technique(s).cell: Agilent 7500cs Q-ICP-MS at PML (B, Zr, Nb, Mo, Sn, Sb, Hf, Ta on same samples; stated section 2.1.1)
Coupled Technique(s).value: Agilent 7500cs Q-ICP-MS at PML (B, Zr, Nb, Mo, Sn, Sb, Hf, Ta on same samples; stated section 2.1.1)

Coupling Description.cell: The SF-ICP-MS measures Ti as the (47Ti + 49Ti)/93Nb ratio; the Q-ICP-MS measures B, Zr, Nb, Mo, Sn, Sb, Hf and Ta on the same solutions and gives the Nb concentration used for Ti — abstract; §2.7
Coupling Description.value: The SF-ICP-MS measures Ti as the (47Ti + 49Ti)/93Nb ratio; the Q-ICP-MS measures B, Zr, Nb, Mo, Sn, Sb, Hf and Ta on the same solutions and gives the Nb concentration used for Ti

Target Material.cell: basalt; andesite; peridotite; carbonaceous chondrite — GSJ and USGS silicate reference materials, and four carbonaceous chondrites (Ivuna, Orgueil, Cold Bokkeveld, Allende)

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Weighed test portion -- "Approximately 20 mg of basalt and andesite samples were weighed"; "Approximately 50 mg for peridotites and approximately 10 mg for meteorites"; 9-18 mg for carbonaceous chondrites
Sampling Unit Type.value: Weighed test portion -- "Approximately 20 mg of basalt and andesite samples were weighed"; "Approximately 50 mg for peridotites and approximately 10 mg for meteorites"; 9-18 mg for carbonaceous chondrites

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Whole-rock powder (decomposed in TFM bomb; same as Q-ICP-MS portion; stated section 2.1.1)
Sample Preparation Method.value: Whole-rock powder (decomposed in TFM bomb; same as Q-ICP-MS portion; stated section 2.1.1)

Digestion Acid(s).cell: ultrasonic HF decomposition: HF; bomb HF decomposition: 30 mol/l HF; re-dissolution: 0.5 mol/l HF — §2.5

Digestion Step.cell: ultrasonic HF decomposition (basalts and andesites, <70 °C); bomb HF decomposition (peridotites and meteorites, 30 mol/l HF, 245 °C, mannitol added); re-dissolution (dried, then 5 ml 0.5 mol/l HF in an ultrasonic bath, fluorides removed by centrifuging) — abstract; §2.5

Digestion Temperature.cell: ultrasonic HF decomposition: <70 °C; bomb HF decomposition: 245 °C; re-dissolution: N — abstract

Final Solution Matrix.cell: all: 0.5 mol/l HF with mannitol, diluted — 'The mannitol and HF concentrations in all samples and standard solutions were diluted to be similar to each other' (§2.5)

Chromatographic Separation Applied.cell: None (direct analysis of 0.5 mol/l HF solution; stated section 2.1.2)
Chromatographic Separation Applied.value: None (direct analysis of 0.5 mol/l HF solution; stated section 2.1.2)

Isotope Dilution Spike.cell: N — Ti is not spiked; the Zr–Hf and Mo–Sn–Sb spikes serve the ICP-QMS elements

Instrument Manufacturer.cell: Thermo Fisher Scientific -- "(b) ICP-SFMS, Finnigan ELEMENT"; stated as "Finnigan ELEMENT", the pre-Thermo brand name
Instrument Manufacturer.value: Thermo Fisher Scientific -- "(b) ICP-SFMS, Finnigan ELEMENT"; stated as "Finnigan ELEMENT", the pre-Thermo brand name

Torch Type.cell: Quartz glass torch with sapphire injector (stated Table in section 2.1.2)
Torch Type.value: Quartz glass torch with sapphire injector (stated Table in section 2.1.2)

Interface Cone Configuration.cell: 1 mm Ni sampler + 0.8 mm Ni skimmer (stated Table in section 2.1.2)
Interface Cone Configuration.value: 1 mm Ni sampler + 0.8 mm Ni skimmer (stated Table in section 2.1.2)

Sampler and Skimmer Cone Material.cell: Ni sampler and Ni skimmer (stated Table in section 2.1.2)
Sampler and Skimmer Cone Material.value: Ni sampler and Ni skimmer (stated Table in section 2.1.2)

Nebulizer Type.value: Micro-flow PFA nebulizer PFA-20 (ESI, USA); self-aspiration (stated Table in section 2.1.2)

Spray Chamber Type and Cooling Temperatu.cell: Scott double-pass, uncooled, Teflon (stated Table in section 2.1.2)
Spray Chamber Type and Cooling Temperatu.value: Scott double-pass, uncooled, Teflon (stated Table in section 2.1.2)

Sample Uptake Rate.cell: Self-aspiration; uptake time 60 s (stated section 2.1.2); volumetric flow rate N
Sample Uptake Rate.value: Self-aspiration; uptake time 60 s (stated section 2.1.2); volumetric flow rate N

Analytical Mode.cell: Solution nebulisation (continuous) -- stated in the acquisition parameters: "Middle resolution 50 s with 30 scans (continuous nebulization)"
Analytical Mode.value: Solution nebulisation (continuous) -- stated in the acquisition parameters: "Middle resolution 50 s with 30 scans (continuous nebulization)"

ICP Tuning.cell: Partially -- an oxide acceptance criterion is registered in the operating conditions, "Oxide forming rate <1% (CeO+/Ce+)"; no tuning solution or tuning procedure stated
ICP Tuning.value: Partially -- an oxide acceptance criterion is registered in the operating conditions, "Oxide forming rate <1% (CeO+/Ce+)"; no tuning solution or tuning procedure stated

Target Species.cell: Ti — 'the analysis of Ti by middle resolution' (§2.1.2); ⁹³Nb is measured as the internal standard

Reported Variables and Units.cell: Ti (µg/g); TiO2 — Ti by ICP-SFMS; Nb is from the ICP-QMS. Detection limits in solution (ng/g) and in rock (µg/g) in Table 2b

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Masses.cell: 47Ti, 49Ti → Ti; 93Nb → none — 'In one scan, 47Ti and 49Ti together with 93Nb were measured. Signals of 47Ti and 49Ti were summed up to determine a total Ti signal' (§2.1.2)

Mass Resolution Assignment.cell: all: middle resolution (M/ΔM = 3000) — 'At this resolution, major interferences on Ti such as 15N16O2+ or 31P16O+ can be separated' (§2.1.2)

Dwell Time per Mass.cell: 47Ti: 0.18 s; 49Ti: 0.18 s; 93Nb: 0.18 s — integration time per 1 s (Table 2b)

Number of Scans per Replicate.cell: all: 30 scans in 50 s — Table 1b 'Middle resolution 50 s with 30 scans (continuous nebulization)'

Analysis Sequence.cell: Standard solution every two samples; each sample measurement ~6 min, including ~3 min washing — §2.1.2
Analysis Sequence.value: Standard solution every two samples; each sample measurement ~6 min, including ~3 min washing

Wash Time Between Samples.cell: ~3 min with 0.5 mol/l HF — §2.1.2; Table 1b: background measured before each sample 'after 200 s wash'

Drift Correction Method.cell: Standard solution every two samples — 'No time drift of fTi was observed during measurements over 2 h, thus all fTi were averaged and used' (§2.7)

Calibration Strategy per Target Species.cell: Ti: two-stage internal standardisation against Nb, X_Ti = X_Nb × f_Ti × S_Ti — S_Ti is the (47Ti + 49Ti)/93Nb intensity ratio and f_Ti the relative concentration factor from the standard solution; X_Nb from the ICP-QMS Nb/Mo and Nb/Zr ratios (§2.7)

value.value: two-stage internal standardisation against Nb, X_Ti = X_Nb × f_Ti × S_Ti

Blank / Background Correction Method.cell: Background measured before each sample after a 200 s wash — Table 1b
Blank / Background Correction Method.value: Background measured before each sample after a 200 s wash

Isotope Dilution Data Reduction Method.cell: N — Ti is determined by internal standardisation, not isotope dilution

Memory Effect Mitigation.cell: 0.5 mol/l HF carrier and wash solution; ~3 min wash per sample — §2.1.2
Memory Effect Mitigation.value: 0.5 mol/l HF carrier and wash solution; ~3 min wash per sample

Uncertainty Level.cell: RSD% with observed ranges in parentheses
Uncertainty Level.value: RSD% with observed ranges in parentheses

Calibration Factor and Determination Met.cell: Ti: relative concentration factor f_Ti against Nb, from the standard solution and averaged over the session; other: N — Eq. 2 (§2.7)

value.value: relative concentration factor f_Ti against Nb, from the standard solution and averaged over the session

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: Partially -- "Orgueil and Allende were analyzed 4 times and twice from the sample digestion, respectively ... analytical results for each run are shown in the table" alongside the averages. No acceptance or rejection rule stated
Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.value: Partially -- "Orgueil and Allende were analyzed 4 times and twice from the sample digestion, respectively ... analytical results for each run are shown in the table" alongside the averages. No acceptance or rejection rule stated

Combination Method.cell: all: average of repeat runs per sample — 'Orgueil and Allende were analyzed 4 times and twice from the sample digestion, respectively ... analytical results for each run are shown in the table' alongside the averages

value.value: average of repeat runs per sample

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: N — 'The standard solution was measured every two samples' (§2.1.2); its Ti and Nb contents are not stated

Secondary Reference Materials.cell: JB-1, JB-2, JB-3, JA-1, JA-2, JA-3, JP-1, BHVO-1, AGV-1, PCC-1, DTS-1 — GSJ and USGS silicate reference materials (§2.3); the chondrites are samples

Detection Limit.cell: Ti: 4 µg/g; other: N — 3σ in rock; 21 ng/g in solution (Table 2b)
